messages:
Ana (Partnerships): hey team — kicking off the SI mentorship batch (Batch 7). short sync: lab schedule, cert exam, mentor pairings, and joint announcement timing.
Matt (Solutions): excited. can we confirm lab environment access by monday? need sandbox + sample infra templates.
onboard-bot: Workspace provisioned: https://redwood.example.com/workspaces/si-batch-7 — creds emailed to leads.
Sara (SI Program): confirmed, onboard-bot has provisioned. i'll drop the terraform templates in the repo by EOD.
Liam (Sales): reminder — we promised a joint announcement with CloudMarket partner. want to align cert dates with the press window.
Ana (Partnerships): good call. proposed timeline: training week (May 3-7), cert exam week (May 10-14), internal dry-run May 17, announcement May 20. thoughts?
Matt (Solutions): timeline looks fine. can we add a fast-track hands-on for SIs doing on-prem installs? small workshop on day 3.
Sara (SI Program): yes — day 3 = "On-prem install clinic" 2 hours. pairing mentors: i'll assign 2 mentors per 4 teams.
Ana (Partnerships): mentors = Matt + Priya for infra, Jorge + Sara for validation. i'll confirm invites.
Liam (Sales): tagging the marketplace team — we need listing readiness checklist: logo, short blurb, support contact, SKUs. Anyone owning that?
Sara (SI Program): i'll own the checklist and gate the listing for certified partners only.
Matt (Solutions): tech checklist draft: repo + sample-llm-config, quantization notes, perf baseline script (run_perf.sh), and a minimal test prompt set. snippet: `./run_perf.sh --model redwood-ggml --seq 512`
Ana (Partnerships): can we add a small eval — 50 prompts — for regression monitoring post-announce? Redwood Optimize team can hook alerts.
Matt (Solutions): yes, i'll coordinate with Optimize and add a placeholder in the repo: EVAL_PROMPTS/50-regression.json
onboard-bot: Reminder set: certification reminders will be sent to participants 3 days and 1 day before exam.
Sara (SI Program): pairing note: mentors will do 30-min office hours slots each day after training. i'll publish signup sheet.
Liam (Sales): regarding the joint announcement — legal needs the blurb by May 13. Ana, can partnerships pull that together?
Ana (Partnerships): i'll draft and circulate by May 11. also looping in CloudMarket partner for co-review.
Matt (Solutions): blockers? any infra quota / GPU access issues for labs?
Sara (SI Program): currently ok but requesting +2 A100s on dedicated pool for perf runs. raised ticket with eng-infra (INC-8793).
Ana (Partnerships): thanks. action items: Sara = publish repo + signup sheet; Matt = perf script + eval hooks; Liam = coordinate marketplace legal requirements; Ana = announcement draft + partner loop; onboard-bot = ensure creds and reminders.
Liam (Sales): :thumbsup:
Sara (SI Program): will follow up with calendar invites once mentors confirm windows.
Ana (Partnerships): perfect — quick standup tomorrow 10am PT. bring any updates to the infra ticket. :raised_hands:
Matt (Solutions): see you then.
onboard-bot: Ticket INC-8793 updated: extra GPU quota requested. ETA 48h.
